states.PRE_DRIVER: official campaign driver absent; expected_execution_identity MUST be null; preflight may pass; EXECUTION REFUSES.
states.FROZEN: driver implemented and independently audited; expected_execution_identity MUST be a 64-hex digest; execution eligible only if the recomputation matches AND execution_authorised is true.

execution_seal.authorisation_is_separate: execution_authorised = true is set by a SEPARATE final authorisation task. A FROZEN seal is not an authorisation, and an authorisation without a FROZEN seal is refused.
execution_seal.why_external: The execution identity hashes the frozen package inputs, which include this plan and its normative Markdown. An expected identity stored inside one of its own inputs is an impossible fixed point, so the assertion lives outside the preimage.
execution_seal.current_pre_driver_identity_is_not_a_sea: The identity preflight reports today is a PRE-DRIVER PACKAGE EXECUTION IDENTITY: a diagnostic, not the final expected value. It will legitimately change when the official campaign driver enters the preimage.
execution_seal.seal_may_not_name_the_driver: The seal used to carry an authoritative driver path checked with os.path.exists. An independent audit showed a correctly FROZEN seal naming e1a_v4/validation/plan.py made the complete execution gate PASS with no campaign driver in existence. The driver is now declared canonically and identity-bound; the seal may only restate it.

plan_authority_coherence.rule: The JSON is the mechanical schema and ordering source; docs/e1a/E1A_V4_SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_PLAN.md is its normative human rendering. Any mismatch is an integrity failure requiring fail-closed refusal (AGENTS.md).
plan_authority_coherence.specification: e1a_v4.validation.coherence declares EVERY top-level, per-case and per-subcondition key of this plan as BOTH (duplicated in the Markdown, checked for equality) or JSON_ONLY (with a stated reason). require_specification_totality REFUSES if the plan carries any key the specification does not classify, so authority cannot be added silently and go unchecked. All reported field counts are derived from this specification; none is hand-counted.
plan_authority_coherence.views: normative_json_view and normative_markdown_view build the SAME flat dotted canonical mapping from the two representations; the comparison names the exact mismatching key.
plan_authority_coherence.generated_region_rule: Each anchor-delimited region is rendered from this JSON and verified BYTE-EXACT at preflight. The visible normative tables are therefore generated, not hand-maintained. Normative content outside a generated region -- the version line, the section-1 identity table, the execution-authorisation sentence, section 9 and section 10 -- is parsed and compared instead.
plan_authority_coherence.strict_json: Authoritative JSON is parsed by e1a_v4.validation.strict_json, which REFUSES duplicate object keys at any depth. json.loads keeps the LAST duplicate while a human reads the FIRST; an authoritative document that states a key twice is ambiguous and neither value is adopted.
plan_authority_coherence.superseded_defect_1: The original preflight compared only the section-9 output schema. The Markdown carried, for four commits, an analysis procedure identity the package has never computed, while preflight reported PASS.
plan_authority_coherence.superseded_defect_2: Its replacement carried only case-level SCALARS in the generated block and read only seven case rows. An independent audit reproduced nine probes that still passed, including visible fields_affected, primary sigma_psi, and the C1 279/300, C7 4/400 and C8 188/200 release thresholds changed in the Markdown alone, and JSON feeds_primary_claim, C7 beta_true and C8 scale_factors changed with the block regenerated. See docs/e1a/E1A_V4_COHERENCE_HARDENING_REPORT.md.

case_count_justification: Eight cases, one per scientifically required purpose traceable to committed or adopted authority. P2 (cross-field) and P3 (absolute) are NOT separate generating cases: they are endpoints evaluated on C1's data so the shared reference-field dependence and the common-mode calibration error are preserved. Simulating the three P2 ratios independently, or reverting P3 to reference-only, would destroy exactly the structure being validated. The count is eight because eight purposes are required, not to preserve a historical number.

branch_b.initialisation: x_0 ~ N(x*, Sigma_theta); stationary at step 0; burn_in_steps = 0

calibration.artifact_schema_note: version 2 carries the complete calibration condition and the precomputed null threshold. A version-1 artifact is REFUSED, not reinterpreted. No official stochastic artifact exists, so the break is free to make explicit now.

bound: H_normalised (H_A / tr H_A: eigenvalue ratios AND orientation)

not_bound.N_ab: exactly determined by (phi_modes, n); the primitives are bound instead, which is strictly stronger
not_bound.rank_tol: never read on the calibration path
not_bound.overall scale of H_A: every Block-1 gate is invariant to H_A -> c H_A in exact arithmetic (verified numerically to ~1e-12 relative), so H_A/tr(H_A) is the canonical representative. The normalisation is NOT bit-invariant in IEEE-754: c*H renormalises to a last-ulp-different matrix, so the digest refuses the rescaled artifact. Fail-closed by one ulp, which is the conservative direction and costs nothing because no cross-field reuse is permitted.

condition_binding.canonicalisation: float.hex() per float, json.dumps(sort_keys, separators, ensure_ascii), sha256. No rounded human-formatted text is ever the identity.
condition_binding.superseded: branch_a_signature bound only the eigenvalue RATIOS and n. theta0_circular and theta1_power are both isotropic, so their ratios are identical, yet their per-element effective sizes differ by a factor of about 1.47 because tau = gamma/k differs by 2.1x. The theta0 artifact was accepted for theta1 and the stored field_id was never compared. branch_a_signature is retained as PROVENANCE ONLY.

ordering.enforced_by: e1a_v4.validation.scope.ReplicateCalibration.validation_seed, which refuses until that field's artifact is locked. The threshold is conditional on Branch A and BLIND to Branch B.
ordering.campaign_level_choice_reason: the preferred PHASE A / PHASE B / PHASE C separation would materialise all 46,000 artifacts before any Branch-B draw. Each artifact carries 4 gates x R_cal = 50000 float64 null draws = 1.6 MB raw, so full Phase-B materialisation is about 74 GB binary and several hundred GB as JSON, against 24 GB of RAM on the reference machine. Streaming is therefore adopted, and it is exactly equivalent because ReplicateCalibration mechanically guarantees that the artifact for a given (case, subcondition, replicate, field) is finalised and immutable BEFORE the first Branch-B validation draw for it, and that no later validation result can alter it.
ordering.auditability_preserved: the artifact MANIFEST is materialised in full for all 46,000 artifacts, about 3 MB of digests, so threshold freezing remains auditable before any validation outcome exists even though the draws themselves are streamed.

calibration.artifact_immutability: finalised artifacts are immutable; the ledger refuses a second lock for the same (case, replicate, field) and refuses any lock after that field's Branch-B stream has been released

A_rotated_ou_generator.defect: the superseded recurrence applied distinct modal phi directly in LABORATORY coordinates. For a field that is both ROTATED and ANISOTROPIC this does not preserve the declared stationary covariance: the diagonal is preserved but every off-diagonal is multiplied by phi_i phi_j + sqrt((1-phi_i^2)(1-phi_j^2)) < 1.
A_rotated_ou_generator.only_affected_field: theta2_ellipse (k = 150/60 uN/m at 30 deg) is the only declared field that is both rotated and anisotropic
A_rotated_ou_generator.measured_distortion: off-diagonal multiplied by 0.935926747418, a 6.4% under-estimate; 1.96e-02 relative to max|Sigma|
A_rotated_ou_generator.correction: evolve independent eigenmodes of H_true and rotate back: F = R diag(phi) R^T, Q = Sigma - F Sigma F^T, and in the eigenbasis Q_ii = (1-phi_i^2)/(beta lambda_i)
A_rotated_ou_generator.verified: F Sigma F^T + Q = Sigma to 0.0 relative residual; Q_eig off-diagonal ~1e-33

modal_ordering.rule: tau_true is ordered WITH ascending H eigenvalues, the jacobi convention
modal_ordering.invariant_enforced: lambda_i * tau_i must be constant across modes (isotropic Stokes drag), which refuses any swapped pairing
modal_ordering.verified: for theta2_ellipse, lambda ascending pairs with tau descending and tau_i = gamma/k_i exactly; a swapped order is REFUSED

beta_covariance.verified: checked at beta = 1.0, 1.06, 0.93, 1.10, 1.025; the stationary covariance tracks 1/beta and the transition identity holds at each
